findings.summary: beforeSwapReturnDelta and afterSwapReturnDelta can bypass concentrated-liquidity swap math and move value across the specified and unspecified currencies. They are enabled deliberately because the mandatory quadrant-dependent quote-side fee cannot be collected without them on the two quadrants where the quote is the specified currency.
